Risk Description:
Risk of loss due
to inability to
meet funding
obligations
Key Risk Indicators:
Liquidity coverage
ratio, funding gap
analysis, deposit
run-off rate
Our Risk Mitigation Strategies:
• Robust liquidity risk management framework.
• Active monitoring and control of liquidity risk exposures
and funding needs.
• Funding strategy focused on diversification in the sources
and tenor of funding.
• Stress testing and Contingency Funding Plan.

Risk Description:
Risk of loss due
to inability to sell
assets or access
funding in a timely
manner
Key Risk Indicators:
Market liquidity
ratios, value-at-
risk, exposure to
illiquid markets
Our Risk Mitigation Strategies:
• Portfolio limits to ensure adequate holding of high liquid
assets.
• Monitoring and reporting of market conditions to ALCO.

Risk Description:
Risk of liquidity
problems
spreading from
one entity to
another
Key Risk Indicators:
Interconnectedness
of financial
institutions, credit
ratings, market
sentiment
Our Risk Mitigation Strategies:
• Monitoring and reporting of market conditions to ALCO.
• Interbank limits.
• Daily monitoring of exposures.

Risk Description:
Risk of sudden and
large withdrawals
of deposits or
other funding
sources
Key Risk Indicators:
Depositor
behaviour, market
rumours, news
events
Our Risk Mitigation Strategies:
• Good governance and ethical practices.
• Proactive monitoring and response to market
developments.
• Stress testing

Risk Description:
Risk of loss due to
changes in interest
rates
Key Risk Indicators:
Exposure to
interest rate-
sensitive assets and
liabilities, value-
at-risk, earnings
at risk
Our Risk Mitigation Strategies:
• Comprehensive interest rate risk management
framework.
• IRR limits, GAP and duration analysis.
• Sensitivity analysis and stress testing.
• Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP).

Risk Description:
Risk of loss due
to changes in
currency exchange
rates
Key Risk Indicators:
Exposure to
foreign currency-
denominated
assets and
liabilities, value-at-
risk (VAR), earnings
at risk
Our Risk Mitigation Strategies:
• Risk limits and monitoring framework.
• Formal separation of front office and back-office
operations.
• VAR calculation and back testing.
• Availability of appropriate skills and technology.
• Portfolio management and segmentation.
• New and existing product management programs.
